title: Silver Sky memo given to Moore as a test

tellings.quote: it was part of a project called Silver Sky because the memo was called the Silver Sky memo. He went and checked it out and found out that was BS too.

plain: A UFO researcher named Bill Moore was handed a document called the Silver Sky memo, supposedly about a secret project named Silver Sky in New Mexico, but when he checked it out he found it was false, apparently given to him as a test. The writer Greg Bishop tells this, passing on what Moore told him: Moore 'went and checked it out and found out that was BS too'. It matters because it suggests people were feeding fake documents to UFO researchers to see what they would do with them.
